setlist.title: Going Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes of the World** (5 reviews): Eyes opened the second set, apparently for the first time in ages, benefiting from a standing start rather than following a jam; Reviewer says the second set was transformational, with Jerry searching and finding a metamorphosis between Victim and China [24][26][29][31][35]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Bird Song into Let It Grow is named as a highlight; Bird Song described as magical and complex, worth repeated listening [29][33]
- **Going Down The Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Reviewer calls this their favorite Going Down the Road Feeling Bad of all time [27]

## The recordings

- **gd90-03-25.fob-schoeps-mattes.miller.28389.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 4.13/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with nice bass, good balance and pleasant ambience; no sound issues in the download [25]
- **gd1990-03-25.142990.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 161 min [2]
- **gd1990-03-25.149394.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 161 min [4]
- **gd90-03-25.sbd.gorinsky.8506.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 4.82/5 by 11 [7]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has heavy cathedral-like reverb typical of spring 1990 boards, which the reviewer finds dizzying [34]

## Around the show

- Reviewer claims a boa constrictor sat at Jerry's feet during the show [26]
- Attendee was stung by a bee up front in cold Albany March weather [32]
- After the show, reviewer heard this Eyes on someone's DAT through headphones at an Albany bar [35]
- Second night of the Knickerbocker Arena run, following a phenomenal first show; the second set is called a monster [24]
- Reviewer notes none of the second set was used on the Dozin' release, and wants the 3/26 show too [26]
- Reviewer owns the Dozin' set and the audience recording presents the whole show, not just the partial release [27]
- Attendee of all three Knick shows in 1990 rates this night the best of the three [31]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-03-25.fob-schoeps-mattes.miller.28389.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: FOB Schoeps CMC4/MK21> Oade Cap Coupled Supply> Dat (Panasonic SV250/48k)> Dat (Cloned From Master) [1]. Also: Recorded by Ted Mattes with Schoeps microphones, going to DAT, then cloned and transferred via Sony R500 to SHN [1]
- **gd1990-03-25.142990.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Ted Mattes DAT Recording (FOB): Schoeps CMC4 MK21 (ORTF) > DAT (Panasonic SV-250); Location unknown; Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1990-03-25.149394.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital Audience Recording by Ted Mattes; transferred by Transfer by Charlie Miller Edited & reMastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 27, 2020; source: From the Teddy Ballgame Archive - a reMaster of shnid 142990 Source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4 MK21 (ORTF) > DAT (Panasonic SV-250) Location: unknown [4]. Also: Remaster corrected an inverted right channel and improved levels with gentle EQ and normalization, after a listener flagged the problem [4]
- **gd90-03-25.sbd.gorinsky.8506.sbeok.shnf**: source: 24 track SBD MR> Healy 2 track Mixdown> C> DAT> CDR>WAV>SHN [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1990-03-25 Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-03-25-knickerbocker-arena-albany-ny-usa/) [38]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-03-26 Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-03-26-knickerbocker-arena-albany-ny-usa/) [39]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-03-25 Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-03-25-knickerbocker-arena-albany-ny-usa/) [40]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-03-26 Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-03-26-knickerbocker-arena-albany-ny-usa/) [41]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1990-03-25 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1990-03-25-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [42]
- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 3/25/90 Knickerbocker Arena, Albany, New York - GDTS mailorder ticket](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/2512580267/) [43]

claims.text: Eyes opened the second set, apparently for the first time in ages, benefiting from a standing start rather than following a jam
Second night of the Knickerbocker Arena run, following a phenomenal first show; the second set is called a monster
Audience recording with nice bass, good balance and pleasant ambience; no sound issues in the download
Reviewer claims a boa constrictor sat at Jerry's feet during the show
Reviewer says the second set was transformational, with Jerry searching and finding a metamorphosis between Victim and China
Reviewer notes none of the second set was used on the Dozin' release, and wants the 3/26 show too

claims.song: Going Down The Road Feeling Bad
claims.text: Reviewer calls this their favorite Going Down the Road Feeling Bad of all time
Reviewer owns the Dozin' set and the audience recording presents the whole show, not just the partial release
Fans realized the second-set opener was Eyes; it was sweet and slow like a 1970s version
Bird Song into Let It Grow is named as a highlight
Attendee of all three Knick shows in 1990 rates this night the best of the three
Second set is laid back and nuanced; Jerry holds back on riffs; considered a classic 1990 Eyes
Attendee was stung by a bee up front in cold Albany March weather
Attendee saw all three Albany shows and three at Nassau Coliseum, calling them very consistent
Bird Song described as magical and complex, worth repeated listening
Soundboard has heavy cathedral-like reverb typical of spring 1990 boards, which the reviewer finds dizzying
Jerry turned Eyes into a slowed, free-form, jazzy exploration, a new era beyond fast 1980s versions
Reviewer prefers this Eyes to 1980s versions and ranks it beside the Branford Eyes; Knick run was the tour's gem
After the show, reviewer heard this Eyes on someone's DAT through headphones at an Albany bar
Recorded by Ted Mattes with Schoeps microphones, going to DAT, then cloned and transferred via Sony R500 to SHN
Partially released as Dozin' at the Knick; complete show later issued in the Spring 1990 box set
Recorded by Ted Mattes, with Charlie Miller as go-between for the transfer
Remaster corrected an inverted right channel and improved levels with gentle EQ and normalization, after a listener flagged the problem
